title: Nvidia and ChipAgents Launch AI Chip Design Test With 16.6% Top Score
summary:
Build-A-Chip-Bench allows developers to measure whether artificial intelligence can autonomously engineer semiconductor hardware. In initial tests of the benchmark released by Nvidia and ChipAgents, the top performing agent, powered by Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1, scored 16.6%. While roughly 40% of tested tasks passed functional verification, only 10% met the physical requirements necessary for a viable chip design.

ChipAgents CEO William Wang said that AI has already reduced chip development cycles from at least 2 years to approximately 1 year. Wang expects subsequent advances in autonomy to shorten that timeline further to 4 to 6 months within the next 12 months.
